intent: TEST for SequencingService at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/sequencing/application/SequencingService.java. JUnit 5 + AssertJ (+ Mockito, reactor-test StepVerifier for reactive code); cover every invariant and behavior below, including failure cases, using only the pinned surfaces of collaborators. Unit under test: Telemetry Sequencing & Windowing use case implementing SequenceTelemetryUseCase. Constructor SequencingService(Duration reorderWindow, int reorderBufferCapacity, Duration windowSize, Duration windowSlide, BoundedEventChannel<TelemetrySampleEvent> sequencedSamples, BoundedEventChannel<TelemetryBackfillDetectedEvent> backfillDetections, BoundedEventChannel<TelemetryWindowClosedEvent> closedWindows). Keeps a ReorderWindow and SlidingWindowAssembler per deviceId (ConcurrentHashMap, per-device serialization). On each sample: BACKFILL -> publish TelemetryBackfillDetectedEvent(sample,false) and buffer; LATE -> publish TelemetryBackfillDetectedEvent(sample,true) only; then every drained sample is published in t_device order as TelemetrySampleSequenced and fed to the assembler whose closed windows are published as TelemetryWindowClosed. flush() drains all and closes windows. Never revalidates. Overflow errors propagate (backpressure).
